Theme.Name: Theme
Theme.Hint: Choose colors and fonts for chat, sidebars, settings, scene controls and Speaker Selector windows. General application/dialog backgrounds and header/body text contrast follow this theme while native controls and fonts remain unchanged. Document sheets, DX3rd-owned windows and Taskbar file pickers retain their own theme. Custom webfonts and user colors are preserved.

Dx3rdLightCardPatch.Name: DX3rd-FVTT light chat card patch
Dx3rdLightCardPatch.Hint: Improves contrast for DX3rd item, info, system, judgment, damage, combat and scene cards in Simple Light. Preserves success, failure and warning meanings and card actions, including HTML logs. Disable to use the system's original colors.

Dx3rdTerminalCardPatch.Name: DX3rd-FVTT terminal chat card patch
Dx3rdTerminalCardPatch.Hint: Uses a monochrome Terminal Green or Red palette for DX3rd chat cards and expanded dice, including HTML logs. Preserves outcome labels and signed values, and highlights completed buttons. Disable to use system styles.

ShowPortrait.Name: Show Portrait
ShowPortrait.Hint: Displays the actor portrait in chat messages.

PortraitSize.Name: Portrait Size
PortraitSize.Hint: Sets the size of portrait images.

AlwaysUseCharacter.Name: Always Speak as Assigned Character
AlwaysUseCharacter.Hint: Sets messages typed directly into the chat input to always be spoken as the assigned character.

AlwaysUseActor.Name: Always Speak as Actor
AlwaysUseActor.Hint: Speak as the token's actor even when a token is selected.

PreventOtherUserCharacter.Name: Prevent Speaking as Player Characters
PreventOtherUserCharacter.Hint: Prevents the GM from speaking as player characters.

ApplyUserColor.Name: Apply User Color
ApplyUserColor.Hint: Applies the user color to the sender name in chat message headers.

EnableChatMerge.Name: Enable Chat Merge
EnableChatMerge.Hint: Hides the header on consecutive messages from the same user with the same portrait.

SidebarMinWidth.Name: Minimum Sidebar Width
SidebarMinWidth.Hint: Sets the minimum width when resizing the sidebar by dragging. (312-400px)

ChatHeaderWebfontCSS.Name: Chat Header Webfont CSS
ChatHeaderWebfontCSS.Hint: Webfont CSS shared by in-game chat headers and exported chat log HTML. The first font-family and single font-weight, font-style, and font-variation-settings values are applied automatically. When empty, Foundry’s inherited font is used with a default weight of 900.
ChatHeaderWebfontCSS.Saved: Chat header webfont CSS has been saved.

Dnd5eTitleWebfontCSS.Name: D&D 5e Header Name Webfont CSS
Dnd5eTitleWebfontCSS.Hint: Webfont CSS applied to the D&D 5e chat header title in-game and in exported HTML. Supplied font-family, font-weight, font-style, and font-variation-settings values take priority.
Dnd5eTitleWebfontCSS.Saved: D&D 5e header name webfont CSS has been saved.

Dnd5eSubtitleWebfontCSS.Name: D&D 5e Header Subtitle Webfont CSS
Dnd5eSubtitleWebfontCSS.Hint: Webfont CSS applied to D&D 5e chat header subtitle information in-game and in exported HTML. Supplied font-family, font-weight, font-style, and font-variation-settings values take priority.
Dnd5eSubtitleWebfontCSS.Saved: D&D 5e header subtitle webfont CSS has been saved.

ChatMessageWebfontCSS.Name: Chat Message Webfont CSS
ChatMessageWebfontCSS.Hint: Webfont CSS shared by in-game chat content and exported chat log HTML. The first font-family and single font-weight, font-style, and font-variation-settings values are applied automatically. When empty, Foundry’s inherited font is used with a default weight of 500.
ChatMessageWebfontCSS.Saved: Chat message webfont CSS has been saved.

ChatDiceWebfontCSS.Name: Chat Dice Webfont CSS
ChatDiceWebfontCSS.Hint: Webfont CSS shared by in-game dice areas and exported chat log HTML. Supplied font-family, font-weight, font-style, and font-variation-settings values take priority.
ChatDiceWebfontCSS.Saved: Chat dice webfont CSS has been saved.

NarratorWebfontCSS.Name: Narrator Webfont CSS
NarratorWebfontCSS.Hint: Webfont CSS applied to the narrator bar and narrator chat cards, including exported HTML. When empty, Foundry’s inherited font is used; the narrator bar defaults to 900 italic and narrator cards to 500 italic.
NarratorWebfontCSS.Saved: Narrator webfont CSS has been saved.

ChatHeaderFontSize.Name: Header Font Size
ChatHeaderFontSize.Hint: Sets the font size of chat headers.

ChatMessageFontSize.Name: Message Font Size
ChatMessageFontSize.Hint: Sets the font size of chat message content.

NarratorFontSize.Name: Narrator Font Size
NarratorFontSize.Hint: Sets the font size of text displayed in narrator mode.

NarratorTypingSound.Name: Narrator Typing Sound
NarratorTypingSound.Hint: Sets the sound file to play during the typing effect in narrator mode. It plays when non-space characters are entered.

NarratorTypingSpeed.Name: Narrator Typing Speed
NarratorTypingSpeed.Hint: Sets the speed at which text appears one character at a time in narrator mode. Smaller values display text faster. (10ms: very fast, 50ms: normal, 200ms: slow)

NarratorChatCard.Name: Narrator Chat Card
NarratorChatCard.Hint: Applies a separate style to chat messages sent in narrator mode.

ChatLogExportBasePath.Name: Chat Log Export Base Path
ChatLogExportBasePath.Hint:
The base path to prepend to image paths in chat logs saved as HTML.
HTTP server: http://localhost:30000

ChatLogExportUseBase64.Name: Save Images as Base64
ChatLogExportUseBase64.Hint: Embed images up to 5MiB each (original file size) as Base64. Duplicate images are stored once. Oversized or unreadable images keep their original URLs and a warning is shown.

ChatLogExportCustomCSS.Name: Chat Log Export Custom CSS
ChatLogExportCustomCSS.Hint: Additional CSS to apply to chat logs saved as HTML. It is applied together with the default CSS.

ChatLogExportShowDiceTooltip.Name: Show Dice Tooltip
ChatLogExportShowDiceTooltip.Hint: When enabled, dice tooltips (detailed roll information) are shown when exporting chat logs.

ChatLogExportHideTimestamps.Name: Hide Chat Timestamps in HTML Export
ChatLogExportHideTimestamps.Hint: When enabled, hides timestamps for individual chat messages in HTML logs. The log export time is always shown.

ChatUtilsForIC.Name: Send as OOC When No Token Is Selected in IC Mode
ChatUtilsForIC.Hint: In Public as Character mode, automatically sends the message as OOC if chat is sent without selecting a token.

ChatLogExportHideCoreButton.Name: Hide Default Chat Log Export Button
ChatLogExportHideCoreButton.Hint: Hides Foundry VTT's default chat log export button.

ChatLogSaveHtmlOnDelete.Name: Save HTML Log When Deleting Chat Log
ChatLogSaveHtmlOnDelete.Hint: When enabled, saves the current chat log as an HTML file before deleting the chat log.

ChatRenderLimit.Name: Rendered Chat Limit
ChatRenderLimit.Hint: When the chat log is near the bottom, old chat DOM nodes are removed to limit the number of rendered messages. Stored chat documents are not deleted. Scrolling upward first restores the contiguous history pruned by this module; older history is then handled by Foundry VTT's native history loader.

ActorGridActors.Name: Registered Speaker Actors
ActorGridActors.Hint: Actor list displayed in Speaker Selector (internal setting)

Keybinding.Hint: Toggle Narrator Mode. The default keybinding is Shift+Space.

ChatPortraitToken.PreviewAlt: Token image preview based on Image Path

ChatSenderEdit.SpeakModeToggleHint: Click to toggle between speaking as actor and speaking as token

Sidebar.Title: Drag to resize the sidebar width. Double-click to reset to the default width.

ChatInput.Title: Drag to resize the chat input height. Double-click to reset to the default height.

Header.Name: OP — Chat card heading font
Header.Hint: Personal font for OP card names and roll titles. Set font-family in .lichsoma-op-font-settings inside webfont CSS. Independent of body, sheet, sender and generic dice fonts. Empty uses the OP theme default.

Body.Name: OP — Chat card body font
Body.Hint: Personal font for OP descriptions, tags, tables, buttons and roll results. Set font-family in .lichsoma-op-font-settings inside webfont CSS. Does not inherit heading, sheet or plain-chat settings.
